other_conditions: Farmer must self‑cultivate their land or cultivate leased land
Applicant must be a small or marginal farmer who obtained the loan through a Kisan Credit Card
Must have a valid Aadhaar number
Must be a valid ration‑card holder
Applicant must be a short‑term crop loan holder
The crop loan must be issued by a recognized bank located in Jharkhand
Family members of a deceased debtor are also eligible
Only one member per family holding a crop loan is eligible
Participation in the scheme is voluntary for all crop loan holders
A nominal application fee of ₹1 is required
Qualifying loan accounts include single and joint loans taken for crop diseases
benefits_summary: Waiver of up to ₹50,000 from standard short‑term crop loan accounts as of 31 Mar 2020.
